title: QuickBind coverage ledger — ad-hoc crosslink
summary: Lightweight cross-team contact and coverage ledger created to stitch ad-hoc owners for a short burst (canary + regional fallback validation). Primary goal: make handoffs visible and track outstanding asks that block validation. Not intended as canonical roster — ephemeral for the week of 2026-06-20.
notes: Context: small pilot of regional fallback routes hit flaky latency during synthetic load on 2026-06-19. We spun up an ad-hoc coverage roster to ensure someone is reachable for quick fixes, rollback decisions, and escalation. Use this sheet in async channel #ops-quickbind and update Last sync when you ping your backup. ACTIONS: (1) Confirm SLA thresholds in OPS-1289, (2) Finalize canary TTL by 2026-06-23, (3) Post-mortem template link in linked_artifacts.
